paragraphs.source_en: Katsunaga, utterly bewildered, waited for the page to hand him the cup. He looked at Harunaga, then at Lady Yodo.

units.source_en: Katsunaga, utterly bewildered, waited for the page to hand him the cup.
units.source_zh: 胜永一脸茫然，等着侍童递过杯子。

units.source_en: He looked at Harunaga, then at Lady Yodo.
units.source_zh: 他看看治长，又看看淀夫人。

paragraphs.source_zh: 胜永一脸茫然，等着侍童递过杯子。他看看治长，又看看淀夫人。

paragraphs.source_en: Lady Yodo suddenly let out a shriek.

units.source_en: Lady Yodo suddenly let out a shriek.

paragraphs.source_en: In that instant, a fierce crackling of flames sounded beneath the eaves outside, followed by a volley of gunfire.

units.source_en: In that instant, a fierce crackling of flames sounded beneath the eaves outside, followed by a volley of gunfire.
units.source_zh: 一瞬间，外面的屋檐下响起了噼里啪啦的燃烧之声，接着是一阵枪响。

paragraphs.source_zh: 一瞬间，外面的屋檐下响起了噼里啪啦的燃烧之声，接着是一阵枪响。

paragraphs.source_en: When Hayami Kai-no-kami failed to return, the Ii army's arquebusiers fired at the appointed hour as a warning signal.

units.source_en: When Hayami Kai-no-kami failed to return, the Ii army's arquebusiers fired at the appointed hour as a warning signal.
units.source_zh: 井伊军的火枪队见速水甲斐守迟迟不回，便在约定的时辰开枪示警。

paragraphs.source_zh: 井伊军的火枪队见速水甲斐守迟迟不回，便在约定的时辰开枪示警。

paragraphs.source_en: “No!” Lady Yodo's cry rang out almost at the same moment as the gunshots.

units.source_en: Lady Yodo's cry rang out almost at the same moment as the gunshots.
units.source_zh: 淀夫人的喊声与枪声几乎同时响起。

paragraphs.source_zh: “不！”淀夫人的喊声与枪声几乎同时响起。

paragraphs.source_en: “Ah—” Kai-no-kami stood frozen. “They truly mean to put us to death!”

units.source_en: “Ah—” Kai-no-kami stood frozen. “They truly mean to put us to death!”
units.source_zh: “啊——”甲斐守呆住了，“他们真要置我们于死地！”

paragraphs.source_zh: “啊——”甲斐守呆住了，“他们真要置我们于死地！”

paragraphs.source_en: Ōno Harunaga opened his mouth wide, but no words came.

units.source_en: Ōno Harunaga opened his mouth wide, but no words came.
units.source_zh: 大野治长张大嘴，却说不出话来。

paragraphs.source_zh: 大野治长张大嘴，却说不出话来。

paragraphs.source_en: Where there is life, there is also death; let the living live and the dying die—what cause is there for regret? At every turn, life leads one into snares and draws one into whirlpools.

units.source_en: Where there is life, there is also death; let the living live and the dying die—what cause is there for regret?
units.source_zh: 有生且有死，生且生矣，死且死矣，何憾之有？

units.source_en: At every turn, life leads one into snares and draws one into whirlpools.
units.source_zh: 人生处处入陷阱，落旋涡。

paragraphs.source_zh: 有生且有死，生且生矣，死且死矣，何憾之有？人生处处入陷阱，落旋涡。

paragraphs.source_en: The women wailed one after another and clung to each other. The men's faces changed sharply as they rose to their feet one after another…

units.source_en: The women wailed one after another and clung to each other.
units.source_zh: 女人发出声声悲鸣，互相抱在一处。

units.source_en: The men's faces changed sharply as they rose to their feet one after another…
units.source_zh: 男人则脸色大变，纷纷站起……

paragraphs.source_zh: 女人发出声声悲鸣，互相抱在一处。男人则脸色大变，纷纷站起……
